locator: Bryce et al. (1996). Sect. 1: the bright core is a rectangle of about 95 by 42 arcsec at position angle about 35 deg; the inner lobes extend about 85 arcsec from the central star; the nebula's major axis is at position angle -55 deg. Sect. 4.1: the core is a ring, its diameter 93 arcsec from the rectangle's major axis. Where each lobe's middle lies on the axis is not printed: it is measured on the bank's picture (packages/bake/authoring/m76/lobe-outline.mts).
